title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.24
summary: Important update: update bundled add-ons and patches together while keeping your complete Kodi setup.

sections.heading: True in-place update
bullets: Update BlackLanturn Installer, open your build and choose Update BlackLanturn. No reinstall or Save Data choices are needed.
Included add-ons and tested BlackLanturn patches update together. Ordinary upstream updates cannot silently replace managed patches.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: All accounts, playback settings, sources, favourites, watched progress, history and other saved data stay in place.
Other add-ons you installed are left alone. Newer compatible ordinary dependencies are retained as complete trees.

sections.heading: Recovery and compatibility
bullets: The update is checked and staged before replacing code. A failed update rolls back; an interrupted update can recover when you reopen the updater.
Restart Kodi after updating. Fresh and Standard installations remain separate options for setting up a build.
